_comment: Spoken context lines for the words that sound identical to another word in the
universe. The robot says "<word>. <line>" for these words only, so a child hearing
"two" knows WHICH spelling is being asked for without ever seeing it written.
The line may contain the word itself (that is how classroom dictation works) but
must never appear as text in the game UI - the bubble always stays "Spell the word!".
Keys must exist in spelling-master.csv; check-spelling-data.py enforces that.
buy: We buy bread at the shop.
